sources.observation: Twin sandstone towers flank two levels of open round arches, with arched louver bays, quatrefoil parapets and a figure on the central gable.
The lower entrance is reached directly from the court. A stair on each flank reaches the upper loggia, whose bays sit behind a low carved railing.

limitations: Heights, small carvings and secondary elevations are estimated. The model includes the loggia, entrance recesses and exterior stairs, with the interior beyond the doors closed.
